prompt.project_info: Photorealistic editorial wedding couple portrait in a luxurious baroque hotel lounge using direct flash and warm ambient fill.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional bride in an embellished white wedding gown with secure coverage and subtle sparkle, elegant updo, minimal jewelry; clearly adult fictional groom in black tuxedo, white shirt, black bow tie, polished shoes.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 full-body couple shot, bride seated on a gilded rococo sofa, groom relaxed on the floor leaning against it, red marble wallpaper with gold veining, Persian carpet, oil portraits, and floor lamp.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard on-camera flash with crisp shadows plus warm ambient room fill; preserve white gown texture and sharp gold furniture detail.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, f/4, ultra-photorealistic skin, crisp furniture, clean edges, subtle film grain, no text or logos.
